title: [Shopify] Fix more-expensive exchange refund: no balancing G/L line, no false processed-order warning
summary: Fixed Shopify exchange refund handling when the replacement item is more expensive than the returned item, eliminating the false processed-order warning and removing the spurious balancing G/L line that forced the credit memo total to zero.
key_points: Exchange line IDs are now fetched up front and excluded from the processed-order conflict detection to prevent false warnings on re-import
The redundancy hash for processed orders now excludes exchange lines for consistent re-import behavior
Credit memo no longer creates a spurious Refund Account G/L line when the refund contains exchange lines
The credit memo total now correctly reflects the customer's remaining payment obligation instead of being forced to zero
Two new unit tests validate the fix for exchanges where the replacement item costs more than the returned item
